findings.title: POST_INTAKE_LIFECYCLE_ROUTING
findings.finding: COMPLETED_PENDING_REVIEW always sets completion_pending_intake=true even after durable intake PASS and writer release
findings.required: Distinguish pre/post-intake with canonical durable intake/review evidence; post-intake uses accepted review route without candidate-only deep authority reads

findings.title: UNPROVEN_ORCHESTRATION_GATE_SYNTHESIS
findings.finding: Hard-coded true lane/DAG/exact-authority/compatibility facts and implicit executable_identity_count=1 lack mechanical proof
findings.required: Repository-evidenced gate facts, missing evidence fails closed, explicit count==1 proof, delegate accepted orchestration.resolve_route without copied algorithms

findings.title: FABRICATED_ARCHITECTURE_SOURCE_IDENTITY
findings.finding: Well-formed arbitrary architecture hash and consistently substituted nonexistent source SHA can pass string-only checks
findings.required: Bind architecture to accepted canonical architecture/policy evidence; resolve claimed source commit through read-only Git boundary, no fetch/network repair
